title: First Territorial Capitol of Kansas
geometryBasis: OpenStreetMap way 654074791 fixes the current footprint and its rotation. Public-domain printed illustration and the historic register document the rectangular rubble-limestone envelope.
sectionBasis: The Pawnee vignette in the 1896 Kansas Souvenir shows original massing and opening rhythm. The federal survey and register document the restored roof, sashes, central doors and surviving stone.
limitations: The present map outline controls the geometry. Its long side is shorter than the approximate length listed in the 1965 historic survey.
Door and shutter profiles, chimney height, stone block pattern and surviving sill details are interpreted. Scope is the capitol exterior.
